real_data_probe.dataset: SPEDIA insider-threat (Zenodo 15495572), real Wazuh host telemetry
real_data_probe.evaluation_protocol: Chronological 60%/40% split; scaler and IsolationForest fitted on the first window only; Wazuh severity hidden until test scoring.
real_data_probe.label: Wazuh alert Level >= 12 (independent rule-severity proxy, not insider ground-truth)
real_data_probe.detector: unsupervised IsolationForest on 7 causal behavioural features (no command/rule text)
real_data_probe.finding: The high-severity events are signature-defined command executions (e.g. /bin/nc) run in-hours at ordinary volume, so they are behaviourally invisible. A behavioural-only detector correctly does not surface them; they are caught by rules. This real-data observation empirically motivates SentinelUEBA's hybrid rules + behavioural design rather than behavioural-only anomaly detection.
